lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered 2D arrangement of high-luminance circular maxima on the posterior flank, organized into three distinct horizontal tiers.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical columns of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal tiers of blobs, creating a grid-like topology.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear ridge characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient across the mid-flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Anatomical indentation on the posterior edge of the second dorsal fin; dark circular focal point on the ventral flank near the caudal peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Longitudinal sequence of small, high-intensity spots along the dorsal edge of the caudal fin.
